idish yuzasidagi yorliqni oʻzgartirmaslik va oʻchirmaslik
idishning tashqi koʻrinishini ortiqcha dekoratsiyalarsiz koʻrsatish

concept.titleUz: Oddiy, toza va qulay kulrang idish
concept.rationaleUz: Bu reklama oddiy va amaliy kulrang idishni sodda studiya muhitida aniq koʻrsatib, uning oddiyligini va har xil vazifalarda qulayligini taʻkidlaydi.
concept.hookUz: Dastlab idish yuzasi yorugʻlikda porlab, uning kulrang rangi va oq yorligʻi yaqqol koʻrinadi.
concept.ctaUz: Sizning oshxonangiz uchun ayni oddiy va qulay idishni hoziroq sotib oling!

shots.descriptionUz: Idish oq yorliqli yuqori yuzasi va kulrang rangining yaqin yoritilgan koʻrinishi.
Idishning umuman koʻrinishi, uning yumaloq shakli va tekis asosi toʻliq tushiriladi.
Idish stolga qoʻyiladi yoki aylantiriladi, uning oddiy va qulay tuzilishi va oq yorliq asosiy eʻtiborni oladi.

result.promptEn: Use the supplied single reference image as the visual authority for an ordinary household container. The product is a grey round dish with a white label visible on its side. Maintain the exact shape, the dull grey color, and the white label without alterations. Do not add brand names or additional decorations. The commercial concept is to highlight the container's simple and practical aspects in a clean studio environment. Begin with a close-up shot focusing on the white label and grey surface under soft, clear lighting that reveals the texture and color precisely. The camera slowly zooms in to show the label details and smooth surface. Transition smoothly to a wider shot framing the whole dish from a slight angle to display its round, flat shape fully. Maintain a steady, slow camera track back. In the final segment, the container is gently set or rotated on a neutral studio table surface, showing usable and simplistic design without any extra props or clutter. Lighting remains soft and even to avoid shadows but emphasize the real material appearance. The entire 8-second clip is paced moderately with smooth cuts and minimalistic style, ensuring the product stays the star and clearly visible. Use natural room tone audio with subtle product handling sounds. Avoid high energy camera moves or artificial lighting effects. The hero ending is a stable front view of the dish with the white label clearly visible, emphasizing its everyday use appeal. Visual quality should be crisp and clean, without heavy shadows or reflections. Fidelity constraints include preserving the original white label’s position and appearance, the grey color shade, the round and flat shape, and avoiding any retexturing or added features that are not present in the reference. Avoid adding any branding text or logos beyond what is visible, no exaggerated gloss or sparkle, and no revealing unseen sides or interiors. The product is always the central focus on a clean neutral background, shot in the vertical 9:16 aspect ratio suitable for Instagram.
assumptionsUz: Idish materiali va hajmi nomaʻlum, shuning uchun faqat koʻzga koʻrinadigan yuzalar koʻrsatiladi.
Faqat bitta idish koʻrsatiladi, uning kulrang va oq yorliqli varianti. Idishning boshqa tafsilotlari tasdiqlanmagan.
reviewNotesUz: Idishning oq yorligʻi va kulrang rangi aniq koʻrsatilishi kerak.
Idish shakli va yuzasi oʻzgarmasligi zarur.
Faqat haqiqiy koʻrinishga asoslangan kamera harakatlari va yoritish qoʻllanilsin.
